claim: NATS 同时覆盖 pub/sub、request-reply、queue group、JetStream、KV、Object Store 六类核心能力
evidence_quote: NATS unifies messaging, streaming, and state into one real-time system

claim: subject 用 . 分层；* 匹配单 token、> 匹配一个或多个 token
evidence_quote: The first wildcard is * which will match a single token. > matches one or more tokens, and can only appear at the end

claim: Request-Reply 通过 inbox subject 实现，多响应取首条
evidence_quote: Reply subjects are called inbox. The first response is utilized and the system efficiently discards the additional ones

claim: Queue Group 自动负载均衡，跨集群走本地优先
evidence_quote: only one randomly chosen subscriber of the queue group will consume a message. The server will pick the cluster with the lowest RTT

claim: JetStream 是 NATS 内置持久化层，支持至少一次/精确一次、三种 retention、复制
evidence_quote: JetStream offers persistence with at-least-once and exactly-once (within a time window) delivery

claim: Key/Value 是 Stream 的语义抽象，KV_* 后缀的 stream
evidence_quote: Buckets are materialized as Streams (with a name starting with KV_)

claim: Object Store 通过 chunking 支持任意大小文件
NATS 部署形态：单节点 → cluster → gateway super-cluster → leaf node 接入边缘
evidence_quote: From a single process to a global super-cluster with leaf node servers

claim: 认证方式：token、user+password、nkey、TLS 证书、JWT/operator、auth callout
evidence_quote: Token Authentication, Username/Password, TLS Certificate, NKEY, Decentralized JWT

claim: Accounts 提供多租户 + 命名空间隔离，export/import 控制跨账户消息流
evidence_quote: isolating them from clients in other accounts... the subject space is not globally shared

claim: Core NATS 至多一次；JetStream 至少一次/精确一次；同一发布者顺序保证，跨发布者无序
evidence_quote: Core NATS, offers at-most-once delivery... NATS implements source ordered delivery per publisher

claim: 生产部署 JetStream 推荐 ≥ 4 核 / 8 GiB；客户端默认 max payload 1 MB / 单节点 65,536 连接
evidence_quote: For production deployment of JetStream, we recommend starting with at least 4 CPU cores and 8 GiB of memory. The default setting for a single server is 65,536
fixes for CVE-2025-30215, a CRITICAL severity vulnerability affecting all NATS Server versions from v2.2.0, prior to v2.11.1 or v2.10.27

claim: Cluster 自动 full mesh gossip，路由只转发 1 跳
evidence_quote: forming a full mesh. Each nats-server instance will only forward messages that it has received from a client to the immediately adjacent nats-server instances

claim: 推荐复制因子 R=3，能容忍单节点故障
evidence_quote: Replicas=3 - Can tolerate the loss of one server servicing the stream. An ideal balance between risk and performance
